[[term-user-identifier]]user identifier::

[[controls]]
== Controls

[[identification]]
=== Identification

[[REQ-4.1.1]]
[.requirement]
==== Unique user identifiers

[.statement]
--
The entity shall assign a unique <<term-user-identifier,user identifier>> to each person.
--

[.testing]
.Testing procedures
[[TP-4.1.1.a]]4.1.1.a:: Examine the account list to verify that each person has a unique user identifier.

[.guidance]
.Guidance
****
The entity shall review identifiers every year.
****
